meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 当用户提供 cmem.ai 的同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub URL 时，Claude 会提取并写入插件配置，使 claude-mem 的记忆钩子生效；随后执行 status 校验，只回显脱敏结果。
howto.when: 用户说“set up claude-mem”“pair claude-mem”“connect cmem”任一指令，或提交 Connect 的令牌、用户 ID、URL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我连接 cmem，这是我的 Connect 配置。
用这个 cmem 同步令牌配置 claude-mem，其余先不填。
say.note: 缺少时只写令牌，其余跳过。

say.text: 本机也有 claude-mem，把同样的凭据也写进设置。

howto.what_en: Given cmem.ai sync token, user ID, and SyncHub URL, Claude extracts and writes them into the plugin config so claude-mem memory hooks work; then runs status and reports masked output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", or supplies the cmem.ai Connect token, user ID, or SyncHub URL.

say_en.text: Pair cmem with my Connect config.
say_en.note: Extracts the three values into the plugin.

say_en.text: Configure claude-mem with this cmem sync token only.
say_en.note: If missing, writes just the token.

say_en.text: Also write the same credentials to my local claude-mem.
